charts.title: TOI-2443 b: orbits around TOI-2443
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2443's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2443 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Naponiello et al. 2025 (2025A&A...693A...7N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NAPONIELLO_ET_AL__2025): P 15.66858 d

charts.title: TOI-2443 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2443 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (31) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 318753380, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 18-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
